Qualitative reference, not exact ground truth; evaluation-only, never training.

native_verification: Thirty native160px triplets copied by SHA; same source/ROI/noise/display metadata and exact noisy/reference panels as V37 first1000. Synthetic exactGT; real independent AHD and separateISO100 are not exact RGB GT. Six completeRGB16 files independently verified by workflow.

procedural_diagnostic.aggregation: Arithmetic PSNR mean across four CFAs per source/condition; 7 equally weighted conditions per source, same protocol/noise pairing.

selection.kind: Photographic experimental reference; no broad promotion or SOTA claim
selection.reasons: Positive full427-photo and unseen primary gain versus own first gate; stronger photographic mean than matched native53/native59 controls.
selection.tradeoffs: Known primary slightly lower with uncertain interval; unseen AHD SSIM lower; significant procedural mean regression, including large low-noise source failures. Selected crops show no decisive visual gain.
selection.next: Stop all3 at2000; investigate low-noise procedural failures before further continuation. Queued batch sweep and DINO GPU checks remain independent execution/performance work.
